title: Comprehensive mapping of mutations in TDP-43 and alpha-Synuclein that affect stability and binding.
authors: Alamri, Sultan H; Haque, Shafiul; Alghamdi, Badra S; Tayeb, Haythum O; Azhari, Shereen; Farsi, Reem M; Elmokadem, Abear; Alamri, Turki A; Harakeh, Steve; Prakash, Amresh; Kumar, Vijay
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD和饱和突变计算研究TDP-43 CTD与alpha-Syn的蛋白-蛋白复合物稳定性与结合亲和力，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作蛋白TDP-43，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Abnormal aggregation and amyloid inclusions of TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) and alpha-Synuclein (alpha-Syn) are frequently co-observed in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, Parkinson's disease, and Alzheimer's disease. Several reports showed TDP-43 C-terminal domain (CTD) and alpha-Syn interact with each other and the aggregates of these two proteins colocalized together in different cellular and animal models. Molecular dynamics simulation was conducted to elucidate the stability of the TDP-43 and Syn complex structure. The interfacial mutations in protein complexes changes the stability and binding affinity of the protein that may cause diseases. Here, we have utilized the computational saturation mutagenesis approach including structure-based stability and binding energy calculations to compute the systemic effects of missense mutations of TDP-43 CTD and alpha-Syn on protein stability and binding affinity. Most of the interfacial mutations of CTD and alpha-Syn were found to destabilize the protein and reduced the protein binding affinity. The results thus shed light on the functional consequences of missense mutations observed in TDP-43 associated proteinopathies and may provide the mechanisms of co-morbidities involving these two proteins.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）和α-突触核蛋白（alpha-Syn）的异常聚集及淀粉样包涵体在肌萎缩侧索硬化症、帕金森病和阿尔茨海默病中常被共同观察到。多项报告显示，TDP-43 C末端结构域（CTD）与alpha-Syn相互作用，且这两种蛋白的聚集体在不同细胞和动物模型中共同定位。进行了分子动力学模拟以阐明TDP-43与Syn复合物结构的稳定性。蛋白质复合物中的界面突变会改变蛋白质的稳定性和结合亲和力，可能导致疾病。在此，我们利用计算饱和突变方法，包括基于结构的稳定性和结合能计算，来系统评估TDP-43 CTD和alpha-Syn的错义突变对蛋白质稳定性和结合亲和力的影响。发现CTD和alpha-Syn的大多数界面突变会使蛋白质去稳定化并降低蛋白质结合亲和力。因此，这些结果揭示了在TDP-43相关蛋白病中观察到的错义突变的功能后果，并可能提供涉及这两种蛋白的共病机制。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
